name: FoilTiltCard
job: A product or team card whose holographic foil sheen and glare shift with the tilt of the card, like a collectible trading card
visitor_action: move pointer over the card to tilt it; on touch, dragging tilts it; arrow keys tilt it when focused
mobile: drag-to-tilt, gentle idle sheen sweep, no device-motion permission needed
motion: card rotates in 3D with spring return, foil gradient and glare track the pointer, idle sheen sweep (reduced-motion: flat card with static soft sheen)
art_direction: Prism foil: pearl-white card stock, rainbow-spectrum foil gradient bleeding to lilac and mint, matte ink type, crisp specular glare
